entries.o: <fe><02><0a><30><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>Now we don't have to\nworry about demons.
<fe><02><0a><30><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><31><00>Lina and I will report\nthis to Grandfather.
<fe><02><0a><30><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>I shall tell Grandfather\nabout Hector and the Maze.
<fe><02><0a><30><31><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>I'll just head on back to\nLina and Fia's place!
<fe><02><0a><30><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>This is the Grove of Repose,\na relaxing spot for us.

<fe><02><0a><30><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>Hi, there. I'm Rebecca.\nRebecca the Harpuria.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><32><32><62><5f><30><30><30><35><00>If you wanna talk, just give\nme a holler.
<fe><02><0e><30><32><32><62><5f><30><32><37><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Going on another adventure?\nTell me the details later.
<fe><02><0e><30><32><33><62><5f><30><32><39><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Looking for the Elder's house?\nYou shouldn't go, nya.
Lina charged right into\nthe Elder's house!<fe><00>Looks like something\ninteresting<a2><51>
(Lina? Oh yeah, that\norange-haired girl...)<fe><00>Is something wrong?
I don't know.<fe><00>But something's bound\nto happen.<fe><00><fc><4b>giggle<fc><4b><a2><43>\nLet's go look!
You don't even know\nwhere that is?<fe><00>It's smack in the middle\nof town!
Yeah! Oh, no! We have to\nget going!<fe><00>We're missing the good\nstuff! Bye-bye, now!
The Elder's house, huh...\nMaybe I should visit it.
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Err, I thought I saw\nsomething on the ground...
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><31><39><00>We're just coming back\nfrom taking a bath.
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><32><37><00>I stepped on something...\nAnd then... what happened?
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><32><38><00>You fell smack on your head.\nI was worried about you.
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><33><30><00>It looks like you stepped on\nthat and slipped.
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><33><35><00>My grandfather would like\nyou to see him.
<fe><02><0a><30><33><32><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Me? Oh, nothing. I-I was\njust hanging around.
<fe><02><0a><30><33><32><62><5f><30><30><33><31><00>Me? Oh, nothing. I-I was\njust hanging around.
<fe><02><09><65><35><32><5f><30><30><33><39><00>It's dangerous<fc><4a> I think\nI'll throw it far away.
<fe><02><0a><30><33><33><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>The water feels so good!\nTake this! Splash!
<fe><02><0a><30><33><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>It makes our skin soft\nand silky smooth, right?
<fe><02><0a><30><33><33><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>Didn't I say so? Now we\ncan just kick back and...
<fe><02><09><65><34><39><5f><30><30><30><30><00>I'm not really sure, but I\nfeel power from it.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><31><63><5f><30><30><30><30><00>This is the entrance to\nthe Crystal Caverns.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><31><63><5f><30><30><30><31><00>The Magic Guild is in\nthe back.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>Magic circle...? There's one\nhere in this cavern.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>It's not a place of any\nreal interest though.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>I couldn't read it, so I\ndon't remember it all.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><31><39><00>Can you try and remember what\nthe letters looked like?
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><34><00>I hope that furthers\nyour interest in the land<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><35><00>and shows you the wonders\nof nature.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><36><00>I hear you succeeded in
using the magic circle.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><37><00>Tell me about your
experiences teleporting.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><38><00>Did you not know?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><33><39><00>The magic circle rarely
succeeds in teleporting.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><30><00>Congratulations on
defeating the demons.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><31><00>I am currently studying
why demons<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><32><00>have their eyes set on
the city of Tetyth.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><33><00>I'd like to examine you\nas a magic specimen.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><34><00>Let me know when you have\nsome free time.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><35><00>I hear you succeeded in
defeating more demons.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><36><00>Congratulations.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><37><00>Which reminds me... Have you
heard the rumors about<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><30><34><38><00>Mireno Cemetery? They
say demons are involved.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><34><00>I have finally translated\nall of the Magic Compendium.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><35><00>Now, I believe magic will\nbecome common practice.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><36><00>I would one day like to\nhear your opinion on magic.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><37><00>After years of studying\nmagic, I can finally see<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><38><00>where magic is going. It's\nall thanks to you.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><63><5f><30><30><30><35><00>Magic circle? The people at\nthe Magic Guild would know.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><63><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Huh? You're back... You look\nbusy, too.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><32><63><5f><30><30><32><36><00>My days are passing by as\nI dig up more crystals.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><63><5f><30><30><34><34><00>I'm almost done with this\nwork. Then I can go outside...
<fe><02><0a><30><34><32><63><5f><30><30><34><38><00>I hope I can see you again\nwith a smile.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Magic circle? I know\nabout it, but why?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>It's in the cavern, but\nyou shouldn't go near it.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><30><39><00>It's been busy around here ever
since demons began appearing.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><30><00>I just became a witch and
I'm still learning.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><31><00>So I don't think I can be
of much help to you.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><36><00>Are you interested in magic?\nWe can study together.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><37><00>I have so many books I still\nneed to read.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><31><38><00>I'd like to go outside once\nin a while, at least.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><32><34><00>Oh, a Moon Lily... That's
a rare item.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>I did an experiment with
one a while back.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><32><36><00>I mixed it with all the
staffs I had,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><32><37><00>and ended up with an
amazing staff by accident.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><32><38><00>Would you like me to try
and make that staff again?
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><34><33><00>Oh well... I would've\nprobably messed up anyway.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><35><32><00>Oh well... I would've\nprobably messed up anyway.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><35><34><00>You came back from the\nruins? That's crazy.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><36><39><00>You might be the owner of\nsome incredible luck.

<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><37><32><00>You came at a good time.
I just made an accesory.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><37><33><00>Cierra has this adult-like
atmosphere,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><37><34><00>so I think she'd look good
in this.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><37><35><00>Hehe... maybe you can score
some points with her<a2><52>
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><30><37><38><00>Are there any interesting\nbooks about white magic?

<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><31><38><00>I heard something
interesting!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><31><39><00>Lina stormed into the
Elder's house!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><32><30><00>I didn't ask why, but it
seemed she was in a hurry.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><33><36><00>Thank you very much.\nYou were a big help.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><36><34><00>Do you have time on your\nhands right now?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><36><35><00>I have to clean this place\nall by myself.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><37><39><00>I'm so busy! Working at the\nGuild is such work!
<fe><02><0a><30><34><33><62><5f><30><31><38><32><00>Lately, I haven't been\ndoing anything for myself.
<fe><02><0a><30><34><31><61><5f><30><30><30><33><00>That's been my fate ever\nsince I came to Riviera...
<fe><02><0e><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><5f><30><30><31><32><00>I have to make sure I'm\nnot forgetting anything.
<fe><02><0e><30><34><32><62><5f><30><31><30><5f><30><30><32><31><00>Literature is something we\ncan't take for granted.
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><32><00>Magic circle? Ask the\npeople at the Magic Guild.
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>The Elder's house? Just go\nback to town. You'll see.
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><34><00>All these demons sure make\nthe world dangerous.
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Hey, that thing you got\ndoesn't look half bad.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><38><00>Can you give me that Rusty\nSword?
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Hey, that thing you got\ndoesn't look half bad.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><32><35><00>Chipped Dagger, right?\nCan I have it?

<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><33><32><00>Blacksmiths are so busy!\nBut I still make deadlines!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><33><33><00>So you keep on protecting\nElendia!
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Hey, that thing you got\ndoesn't look half bad.

<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><38><30><00>Wha!? I-Is that really a\nDiamond Teardrop!?<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><38><31><00>I never thought I'd see\none with my own eyes!

<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><38><35><00>Alright! I'll put my body
and soul into this!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><38><36><00>It'll take a little longer
than normal,<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><38><37><00>but it should be done by
the time you get back.
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><39><38><00>Thanks to you, I can do\nmy job as blacksmith!
<fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><30><30><37><00>Hey, that thing you got\ndoesn't look half bad.<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><36><33><62><5f><30><31><30><34><00>Can I have that\nAquarium Fragment?
<fe><02><0a><30><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><30><00>What was that noise? I see\nsomething moving there.
<fe><02><0a><30><37><32><62><5f><30><30><30><33><00>I'm not a kid anymore!\nI can climb trees now.
<fe><02><0a><30><37><32><63><5f><30><30><30><32><00>You're not supposed to go\nnear the magic circle!<fe><00><fe><02><0a><30><37><32><63><5f><30><30><30><33><00>That's what the grown-ups\nsay.
